MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Excretion and osmoregulation in fishes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fish feeds and feeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Record keeping in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovation in Aquaculture 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Conservatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
